sourceTitle: Google for Mexico: Technology impact that goes beyond business
originalTitle: Google for Mexico: Technology impact that goes beyond business
author: Sebastian Valverde

blocks.text: Nearly a year ago, I arrived in Mexico after leading our operations in Miami, with a very clear mission: to continue making Google the best partner for every entrepreneur, business, institution, and person looking to grow here. I knew I was joining a vibrant ecosystem, but reality far exceeded every expectation. In this time, I’ve discovered a country that refuses to be a bystander to the future; Mexico challenges it, embraces it with remarkable speed, and, above all, builds it with its own hands.
blocks.zh: 大约一年前，在领导我们在迈阿密的运营之后，我来到墨西哥，肩负着一个非常明确的使命：继续让 Google 成为每一位希望在这里成长的企业家、企业、机构和个人最好的合作伙伴。我知道自己加入的是一个充满活力的生态系统，但现实远超每一个期待。在这段时间里，我发现这个国家拒绝做未来的旁观者；墨西哥挑战未来，以惊人的速度拥抱未来，并且最重要的是，用自己的双手建设未来。
blocks.en: Nearly a year ago, I arrived in Mexico after leading our operations in Miami, with a very clear mission: to continue making Google the best partner for every entrepreneur, business, institution, and person looking to grow here. I knew I was joining a vibrant ecosystem, but reality far exceeded every expectation. In this time, I’ve discovered a country that refuses to be a bystander to the future; Mexico challenges it, embraces it with remarkable speed, and, above all, builds it with its own hands.

blocks.text: Going from promise to everyday action
blocks.en: Going from promise to everyday action

blocks.text: For years, we spoke about artificial intelligence as a scientific marvel or an assistant capable of answering questions. Today, however, we are witnessing a fundamental turning point: AI has evolved from providing answers to taking concrete action. It’s no longer just about drafting an email or summarizing a document; it’s about intelligent agents solving complex, multi-step tasks, freeing up valuable time for what truly matters.
blocks.zh: 多年来，我们谈论人工智能时，往往把它当作一项科学奇迹，或是一个能回答问题的助手。但如今，我们正见证一个根本性的转折点：人工智能已经从提供答案发展到采取具体行动。它不再只是起草一封电子邮件或总结一份文件，而是让智能体解决复杂的多步骤任务，为真正重要的事情腾出宝贵时间。
blocks.en: For years, we spoke about artificial intelligence as a scientific marvel or an assistant capable of answering questions. Today, however, we are witnessing a fundamental turning point: AI has evolved from providing answers to taking concrete action. It’s no longer just about drafting an email or summarizing a document; it’s about intelligent agents solving complex, multi-step tasks, freeing up valuable time for what truly matters.

blocks.text: And when innovation lands in the real world, results are measured in tangible growth. In our latest Economic Impact Report, we confirmed that Google’s tools contributed over 382 billion Mexican pesos in economic activity across Mexico in 2025. Put into perspective, that’s more than 1 billion pesos flowing through local businesses every single day. Behind that number are the real stories that inspire us: for every peso a business invests in Google Ads, it earns an average of eight pesos in commercial return. Whether it’s the neighborhood fonda managing reservations seamlessly or a company modernizing its operations in the cloud, technology only carries real value when it creates shared prosperity.
blocks.zh: 当创新落地到现实世界时，成果会以切实的增长来衡量。在最新的《经济影响报告》中，我们确认 2025 年 Google 的工具为墨西哥全国的经济活动贡献了超过 3820 亿墨西哥比索。换个角度看，这相当于每天有超过 10 亿比索流经本地企业。这个数字背后是鼓舞我们的真实故事：企业在 Google Ads 上每投入 1 比索，平均可获得 8 比索的商业回报。无论是街边小餐馆无缝管理订位，还是企业将运营迁移到云端实现现代化，技术只有在创造共同繁荣时才具有真正的价值。
blocks.en: And when innovation lands in the real world, results are measured in tangible growth. In our latest Economic Impact Report, we confirmed that Google’s tools contributed over 382 billion Mexican pesos in economic activity across Mexico in 2025. Put into perspective, that’s more than 1 billion pesos flowing through local businesses every single day. Behind that number are the real stories that inspire us: for every peso a business invests in Google Ads, it earns an average of eight pesos in commercial return. Whether it’s the neighborhood fonda managing reservations seamlessly or a company modernizing its operations in the cloud, technology only carries real value when it creates shared prosperity.

blocks.text: Solving the challenges that matter together
blocks.zh: 共同解决真正重要的挑战
blocks.en: Solving the challenges that matter together

blocks.text: At Google for Mexico 2026, we reaffirmed that this potential goes far beyond business. For example, it can help us tackle urgent challenges like climate change and hurricane seasons. Google’s cutting-edge science can provide weather prediction hour by hour, and with up to 15 days in advance. We put that technology to work, partnering closely with the National Water Commission (CONAGUA) and the National Meteorological Service to support the forecast for extreme weather events and deliver more precise real-time alerts directly to people’s phones.
blocks.zh: 在 Google for Mexico 2026 活动上，我们重申这一潜力远远不止于商业。例如，它可以帮助我们应对气候变化和飓风季节等紧迫挑战。Google 的前沿科学能够提供逐小时的天气预报，并且可提前长达 15 天。我们将这项技术投入应用，与国家水务委员会（CONAGUA）和国家气象局紧密合作，支持极端天气事件的预报，并将更精准的实时警报直接发送到人们的手机上。
blocks.en: At Google for Mexico 2026, we reaffirmed that this potential goes far beyond business. For example, it can help us tackle urgent challenges like climate change and hurricane seasons. Google’s cutting-edge science can provide weather prediction hour by hour, and with up to 15 days in advance. We put that technology to work, partnering closely with the National Water Commission (CONAGUA) and the National Meteorological Service to support the forecast for extreme weather events and deliver more precise real-time alerts directly to people’s phones.

blocks.text: At the same time, access must never be a luxury. That’s why we are launching the Gemini app for lower memory Android devices in Mexico, redesigned to run smoothly on phones with as little as 2 GB of RAM. Millions of students and local business owners now have access to guided tutoring, voice interaction, and creative assistance in the palm of their hands. And because the future belongs to the next generation, Google.org contributed with $1.65 million in funding to UNICEF to support digital literacy and online safety programmes for children and adolescents across Latin America. In Mexico, UNICEF will use this support to reach more than 300,000 parents, caregivers, teachers and students with practical tools to help prevent and identify online risks early.
blocks.zh: 与此同时，访问权限绝不应成为一种奢侈品。因此，我们在墨西哥推出面向低内存 Android 设备的 Gemini 应用，经过重新设计，能够在仅有 2 GB RAM 的手机上流畅运行。数百万学生和本地企业主现在可以在掌上获得引导式辅导、语音交互和创意辅助。而且，由于未来属于下一代，Google.org 向 UNICEF 提供了 165 万美元资金，用于支持拉丁美洲儿童和青少年的数字素养和网络安全项目。在墨西哥，UNICEF 将利用这笔支持，为超过 30 万名家长、看护人、教师和学生提供实用工具，帮助他们尽早预防和识别网络风险。
blocks.en: At the same time, access must never be a luxury. That’s why we are launching the Gemini app for lower memory Android devices in Mexico, redesigned to run smoothly on phones with as little as 2 GB of RAM. Millions of students and local business owners now have access to guided tutoring, voice interaction, and creative assistance in the palm of their hands. And because the future belongs to the next generation, Google.org contributed with $1.65 million in funding to UNICEF to support digital literacy and online safety programmes for children and adolescents across Latin America. In Mexico, UNICEF will use this support to reach more than 300,000 parents, caregivers, teachers and students with practical tools to help prevent and identify online risks early.

blocks.text: Building from Mexico for the world
blocks.zh: 从墨西哥出发，为世界而建
blocks.en: Building from Mexico for the world

blocks.text: Coming soon, we will open our new offices in Mexico City, bringing more than a thousand Googlers together under one roof. Among them are world-class Mexican software engineers already developing global products like Google Chrome.
blocks.zh: 不久之后，我们将在墨西哥城启用新办公室，将一千多名 Google 员工汇聚在同一屋檐下。其中就有世界级的墨西哥软件工程师，他们已经在开发 Google Chrome 等全球产品。
blocks.en: Coming soon, we will open our new offices in Mexico City, bringing more than a thousand Googlers together under one roof. Among them are world-class Mexican software engineers already developing global products like Google Chrome.

blocks.text: Mexico no longer just uses technology; it creates it, transforms it, and projects it to the world. Being part of this journey is an immense privilege. Let’s keep building a future where technology is, above all, a bridge so that no one is left behind.
blocks.zh: 墨西哥不再只是使用技术；它创造技术、改造技术，并将其推向世界。能参与这段旅程是莫大的荣幸。让我们继续建设这样一个未来：技术首先是一座桥梁，让没有人被落下。
blocks.en: Mexico no longer just uses technology; it creates it, transforms it, and projects it to the world. Being part of this journey is an immense privilege. Let’s keep building a future where technology is, above all, a bridge so that no one is left behind.
